segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are divided: some say it must be limited to once a week or it becomes too intense and leaves skin red and irritated, while others, including some with rosacea, describe it as surprisingly gentle.
segments.combination: A reviewer with sensitive, combination skin reports needing to space out use every couple of days to avoid irritation.

concerns.redness: Several reviewers with sensitive skin report redness or irritation, especially with frequent use, while others say it caused zero irritation even on rosacea-prone skin when used sparingly.
concerns.aging: One reviewer specifically sought it out as an anti-aging step in her routine and found her skin felt smoother and looked renewed.

extraits.titre: Not for sensitive skin and only gave short term finishing
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This instant glow exfoliator definitely delivers you a refreshed and smooth feeling skin right after use, but then after a few tries it really gets too intense. I have somewhat sensitive skin and found I couldn't use this more than once a week or my skin really paid for it. Maybe those with less sensitive skin found more long lasting positive results, but this really wasn't a hit for me. And with it being so pricey it feels like a splurge fad purchase rather than something to work into your routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The goop exfoliate has tiny beads inside to create a slightly coarse texture. I appreciate that the beads aren't super abrasive. The scent is something that I could not get past - it has a weird citrus odor. One of the big negatives for me that it isn't pregnancy safe! There are many great products out there these days that are pregnancy safe so it's a bummer that this isn't one of them.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This exfoliator was pretty aggressive for me. I have a little more sensitive skin and it left me red and irritated. I have found that if I use a very tiny amount and BARELY touch my face it doesn't irritate me. It does do a great job. My skin is very soft after. It doesn't leave my skin feeling tight at all, which is something that happens a lot. It leaves me glowy and bright. Overall, I do like the product. I can only use it about once a week. It will probably last me a lifetime at this rate!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The good Beauty Microdermm Instant Glow Exfoliator definitely works. For my sensitive, combo skin, I had to use it every 2 days, or my skin felt irritated. A little goes a long way, and my skin feels smoother after ever use. Using this exfoliator with the Nourishing face cream works really well for skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was a bit hesitant at first to try this out because I have rosacea and very sensitive skin but after using it, this product made my skin feel so soft and smooth. It leaves such a beautiful glow on your face! It is a bit pricey but a little goes a long way!

extraits.titre: Gentle in skin even with rosacea!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how gently this exfoliated is. I have rosacea and exfoliation irritates my skin but this one dis not. My skin tends to be very dry and this took off the dead skin and my face immediately felt softer and looks clearer.
